ranked_facts.why: Necrolytic migratory erythema is a characteristic skin lesion associated with glucagonoma, a type of pancreatic tumor, which is more closely related to B4 (Neoplastic Disorder) than to other candidate branches.

Hyperglycemia is a key feature of several metabolic and endocrine disorders, including those represented by B1, B4, and B5, but is less characteristic of inflammatory/autoimmune and infectious disorders represented by B2 and B3.
